description: This circular walk explores the countryside and woods surrounding the Wiltshire village of Erlestoke. In the spring months you can look out for lots of pretty bluebells in the woodland areas. There's also lots of wildlife with woodland birds and deer to look out for. The route runs for about 3 miles and includes some small climbs but is generally fairly flat. The Wessex Ridgeway and the Imber Range Perimeter Path both run to the south of the village. You could pick up these long distance trails to further explore the area.
